requested_outcome: Repair the events-place slider so it exposes the available venue inventory through working RTL navigation, and center and size every affected place-card checkmark consistently.
natural_destination: VII events landing and event place-card family on desktop and mobile
authorization_boundary: Source changes and local verification are authorized. Production publication remains excluded until Adir explicitly approves deployment of this candidate.

lesson_bundle.reason: A reported public defect requires exact-family evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require natural-surface and regression evidence before completion.
Exercise enabled and disabled arrows, first and last boundaries, pointer and keyboard behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The rail and card geometry change at mobile breakpoints.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify desktop, 390px and low-height behavior without overflow or clipping.

lesson_bundle.reason: The checkmark defect is geometric and shared.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Measure icon box, glyph centering, size and alignment across affected cards.

lesson_bundle.reason: The affected surfaces contain Hebrew labels.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve the approved modern Hebrew font stack and direction.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only four venues remain in the general event rail or arrows do not reveal the rest.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove the hard four-item cut and use the geometry-aware event rail for the complete venue set.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The rendered rail contains the full catalog count and its next arrow advances until the final boundary.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The checkmark is technically centered by CSS but still looks low or oversized.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Replace baseline text glyphs with a shared fixed-viewBox SVG icon inside a grid-centered box.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Bounding boxes are centered and desktop/mobile screenshots show balanced optical alignment.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The targeted fix changes card copy, images, contacts or other sliders.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Limit edits to event landing rail composition and the shared event feature checkmark primitive.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Existing card content, gallery, phone, WhatsApp and unrelated rails remain unchanged.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Rendering all venues makes the page feel slower or leaves a white image after moving the rail.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep images lazy, cards compact and warm only the next rail-width of images before navigation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Build passes, the rail remains responsive and the next visible card image is already painted while exposing every venue.

affected_family: Hebrew RTL and localized LTR variants

midpoint_gate.trigger: After focused source tests and the first locally rendered desktop event page, before full regression.
checks: rail item count matches catalog count
next control is enabled when overflow exists
checkmark SVG is centered in both event feature families

attack_questions: Can the rail still stop after four venues?
Can an RTL arrow look enabled but fail to move?
Can the checkmark sit off-center after wrapping or at 390px?
Did the change alter contact, gallery or availability behavior?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A locally rendered exact candidate inspected on the events landing and an event detail route at desktop and 390px.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused contracts, full type/build checks and paired desktop/mobile geometry captures for the two changed families.

effectiveness.baseline: Public version 534 exposes only four cards in the general events section and uses baseline text checkmarks in event feature cards.
effectiveness.target: One focused candidate with no hard venue truncation, working rail boundaries and optically centered checkmarks, without unrelated UI changes.
